journal.text: Opening allocation for new $50k account. Built a diversified core basket of 8 mega-cap/quality growth names spanning cloud/software (MSFT), AI compute (NVDA, AVGO), search/ads (GOOGL), e-commerce (AMZN), social/AI (META), industrial gases defensive quality (LIN), and consumer staples retail (COST). Equal-weighted ~$5,500 each (~$44,000 total, 88% deployed), keeping ~$6,000 cash buffer for opportunistic buys or to average down if there's a pullback. Avoided TSLA (high volatility, negative momentum last 30 days) and AAPL (choppy, underperforming peers recently) for this initial tranche, plus avoided single-name concentration given no macro edge yet on day one. Will reassess after a few sessions of price action: if any position drops >8-10% from entry without thesis change, consider adding; if account gets a clear momentum leader, may rotate cash buffer there. No prior journal history to reference since this is the first session.

This is a broad, market-wide risk-off day rather than a name-specific opportunity, so chasing dips here without more confirmation seems premature - could easily be a one-day macro scare that reverses, or could be the start of something bigger. Holding ~51k cash (50% of net worth) as dry powder given elevated uncertainty post weak jobs data. Will act on: (1) any single holding breaching -8-10% from avg cost - add; (2) a clear multi-day stabilization/breakout after this selloff in an eligible name - initiate; (3) further broad market deterioration (multiple names down >10% from recent highs with no bounce) - consider modest defensive tilt or selective quality adds; (4) cash staying this high for another week with no red flags - start deploying gradually even without perfect setups.
